description: IsoExperiments Experiment 2 — physically comparable Enc/Dec/Both CRB on P0-A common isotropic grid (Run 0). Same split as Experiment 1.
patient_split_method: same as Experiment 1: train P1,P2,P6–P9 · hold-out P3–P5
val_split_method: per train patient: Random(val_split_seed + patient_index).shuffle(100 pairs); take first 10% as val.
target: raw DVF in iso-voxels (1 vx = 2 mm); lung-masked MSE; metrics reported in mm
